# Dermasculpt Clinic - AI and Search Engine Summary

Dermasculpt Clinic is a skin, hair, laser, and anti-ageing clinic in Jayanagar, Bangalore. It is led by Dr. Deepak Devakar (MBBS, DVD), with 18+ years of clinical dermatology experience. The clinic provides dermatologist-supervised treatments for acne, pigmentation, laser hair reduction, PRP/GFC hair therapy, scar revision, skin brightening, tattoo removal, mole removal, wart removal, hair restoration, and facial rejuvenation.
